what: The blob's Shadertoy, GLSL, WGSL, WebGL and WebGPU texts (blobShader) for six palettes and looks, each checked against the site's player in headless Chromium with the shader lab (W/shader-lab, ports/blob.mjs): pixel for pixel, the pages on SwiftShader and the RTX's WebGL, the Shadertoy text on SwiftShader.

texts.shadertoy:
// grabient kY4mpDazO-mUuu_fuLqXU49dvVP6
// https://grabient.com/kY4mpDazO-mUuu_fuLqXU49dvVP6?style=blob&shape=414
// the blob, the palette's balls melted and frosted, for Shadertoy, a section a tab, each tab's channels as its header says
//
// Buffers A to D each in Shadertoy's tab of the name, the Image in Image, each tab's channels as its header says.
// It needs Shadertoy's 32-bit float buffers (its fallback, half floats, cannot hold its numbers) and a canvas at least
// 103 pixels wide: without either it shows magenta. An edit to Common's settings shows at once; rewind plays it
// again from its first frame.
// Its time is Shadertoy's iTime. Where iTime is the float of a whole number of 240ths of a second, a frame's time on a
// 30, 60, 120 or 240 Hz screen whose clock counts from the first frame, it reads that many 240ths exactly, the time the
// site's player has for the frame; any other time it reads as the float it is. So timed, its frames are the player's
// own, pixel for pixel, where the GPU rounds the player's 8-bit noise and half-float melt as Shadertoy's float buffers
// do here (SwiftShader does). A GPU that rounds them its own way draws the player otherwise there, by a level or a few
// at the frost's grain and the melt's edge, and this text cannot know it.

// ==== Common ====
// The blob's settings, as its address writes them: edit them here. An edit shows at once.
const float SPEED = 1.0;   // the loop's pace, two decimals: it lasts 48 s over this; 0 holds the frame it is on
const float FPS = 60.0;    // frames a second at most, 1 to 120
const float FROST = 1.0;   // the frost, two decimals: 1 as designed, 0 none, 2 twice
const uint BG = 0x00000000u;   // the ground as 0xRRGGBBAA, its alpha last; 0u for none, which shows black here
const float EASE = 1.6;    // seconds from rest to its pace, two decimals
// The colors the balls are painted in, 0xRRGGBB, one a ball, far blob to near: the palette across each blob at
// 90 degrees. The blobs' forms and wanderings (shape 414) are Buffer A's BLOBS and BALLS. Both are worked out
// from the palette's curve and the shape's numbers by the site's own code: another angle or shape is another text.
const uint COLORS[24] = uint[](
  0xf9d559u, 0xff9780u, 0xfd5dd2u, 0xfd5bd2u, 0xff8b91u, 0xf9d157u, 0xfabe52u, 0xff9188u,
  0xfea968u, 0xfad85bu, 0xf8c852u, 0xfd7baeu, 0xfe5ad1u, 0xfd62d1u, 0xf8cb53u, 0xff9188u,
  0xfad65au, 0xf8cf55u, 0xff859bu, 0xfe5bd2u, 0xfd5ed3u, 0xff9d77u, 0xfad85cu, 0xff9188u
);

// Buffer A's first row keeps the player's numbers in its blue and alpha, two to a texel; a double in two texels.
const float MAGIC = 4097.5;   // the state's mark, which no half float holds
const int T_MARK = 0;     // the mark and the scene: the state is this text's
const int T_STAMP = 1;    // the canvas the layout was made for
const int T_SIGN = 2;     // the settings the layout was made for, as one number in two halves
const int T_SEEN = 3;     // the canvas a frame before T_STAMP's, or -1 where that frame began afresh
const int T_FLAGS = 4;    // whether this frame draws, whether the pace has begun
const int T_CLOCK = 5;    // the clock: the loop's seconds, the ease's, the frame's time and the pace's in ms, the share drawn
const int T_LAYOUT = 15;  // the design's map (its scale, tx, ty), the melt's corner, a texel's inverse, the clock's settings
const int T_MELT = 35;    // the melt's texels across and down
const int T_TAPS = 36;    // the blur's taps, and whether the frost is drawn
const int T_REGION = 37;  // the filter region in whole pixels, x0, y0, x1, y1
const int T_ORIGIN = 39;  // the melt's corner in pixels
const int T_TEXEL = 40;   // pixels a texel spans, and the scatter across
const int T_SCATTER = 41; // the scatter down, and the speckle's k1
const int T_K = 42;       // the speckle's k2
const int T_GROUND = 43;  // the ground, premultiplied
const int T_WEIGHTS = 45; // the blur's 20 weights
const int T_BALLS = 55;   // each ball: its middle in the melt's texels, and its radius
const int STATE = 103;
vec2 state(sampler2D a, int i) { return texelFetch(a, ivec2(i, 0), 0).ba; }
// as the player's half-float texture keeps it
vec4 half4(vec4 v) { return vec4(unpackHalf2x16(packHalf2x16(v.xy)), unpackHalf2x16(packHalf2x16(v.zw))); }
float weight(sampler2D a, int i) {
  vec2 w = state(a, T_WEIGHTS + i / 2);
  return (i & 1) == 0 ? w.x : w.y;
}
// the player's blur: a Gaussian across or down the melt, its taps from the middle out
vec4 blur(sampler2D source, sampler2D a, ivec2 at, ivec2 size, ivec2 step_by) {
  int taps = int(state(a, T_TAPS).x);
  vec4 sum = texelFetch(source, at, 0) * weight(a, 0);
  for (int i = 1; i <= 19; i++) {
    if (i > taps) break;
    ivec2 p = at + step_by * i;
    ivec2 q = at - step_by * i;
    if (p.x < size.x && p.y < size.y) sum += texelFetch(source, p, 0) * weight(a, i);
    if (q.x >= 0 && q.y >= 0) sum += texelFetch(source, q, 0) * weight(a, i);
  }
  return sum;
}
bool inMelt(sampler2D a, vec2 fragCoord) {
  vec2 size = state(a, T_MELT);
  return fragCoord.x < size.x && fragCoord.y < size.y;
}
bool drawing(sampler2D a) { return state(a, T_FLAGS).x != 0.0; }
// a byte as the GPU reads an 8-bit texel: times the float nearest 1 / 255
const float BYTE = 0.003921569;

// Doubles as their two words, high first: JavaScript's arithmetic, rounded to nearest even, with no branch.
// c is 1 or 0: x where it is 1, y where 0.
uvec2 sel(uint c, uvec2 x, uvec2 y) {
  uvec2 m = uvec2(0u - c);
  return (x & m) | (y & ~m);
}
int seli(uint c, int x, int y) { return int((uint(x) & (0u - c)) | (uint(y) & ~(0u - c))); }
uvec2 add64(uvec2 a, uvec2 b) {
  uint lo = a.y + b.y;
  return uvec2(a.x + b.x + uint(lo < a.y), lo);
}
uvec2 sub64(uvec2 a, uvec2 b) { return uvec2(a.x - b.x - uint(a.y < b.y), a.y - b.y); }
uint lt64(uvec2 a, uvec2 b) { return uint(a.x < b.x) | (uint(a.x == b.x) & uint(a.y < b.y)); }
// by n bits, 0 from 64 up
uvec2 shl64(uvec2 a, int n) {
  uint s = uint(n) & 31u;
  uvec2 low = uvec2((a.x << s) | ((a.y >> 1) >> (31u - s)), a.y << s);
  return sel(uint(n < 32), low, sel(uint(n < 64), uvec2(a.y << s, 0u), uvec2(0u)));
}
uvec2 shr64(uvec2 a, int n) {
  uint s = uint(n) & 31u;
  uvec2 low = uvec2(a.x >> s, (a.y >> s) | ((a.x << 1) << (31u - s)));
  return sel(uint(n < 32), low, sel(uint(n < 64), uvec2(0u, a.x >> s), uvec2(0u)));
}
// shifted right, any 1 shifted out kept in bit 0
uvec2 shrSticky(uvec2 a, int n) {
  uvec2 r = shr64(a, n);

// feTurbulence fractalNoise, two octaves, as Ganesh computes it (the player's bake), at a pixel's middle
vec2 gradient(int index, int channel) {
  uint g = GRADIENTS[channel * 256 + (index & 255)];
  vec4 b = vec4(g & 255u, (g >> 8) & 255u, (g >> 16) & 255u, g >> 24) * BYTE;
  return (b.ga + b.rb * 0.00390625) * 2.0 - 1.0;
}
int selector(float x) {
  int at = int(x) & 255;
  uint l = (LATTICE[at >> 2] >> (8 * (at & 3))) & 255u;
  return l == 255u ? 256 : int(l);
}
vec4 turbulence(vec2 fragCoord) {
  // the design's map as the player's floats hold it: scaled to cover the canvas, centered. Its side times
  // iResolution.z, which is 1, so no compiler divides by a constant's reciprocal instead (as SwiftShader's does)
  vec2 R2 = iResolution.xy;
  float scale = max(R2.x, R2.y) / (500.0 * iResolution.z);
  vec2 offset = R2.x >= R2.y ? vec2(0.0, (R2.y - R2.x) * 0.5) : vec2((R2.x - R2.y) * 0.5, 0.0);
  vec2 v = ((fragCoord - offset) / scale + 0.5) * 0.75;
  vec4 sum = vec4(0.0);
  float ratio = 1.0;
  for (int octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
    vec2 f0 = floor(v);
    vec2 f = v - f0;
    vec2 s = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    int i = selector(f0.x);
    int j = selector(f0.x + 1.0);
    int y = int(f0.y);
    int b00 = i + y, b10 = j + y, b01 = i + y + 1, b11 = j + y + 1;
    vec4 n;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      float u = dot(gradient(b00, c), f);
      float w = dot(gradient(b10, c), f - vec2(1.0, 0.0));
      float a = mix(u, w, s.x);
      w = dot(gradient(b11, c), f - vec2(1.0));
      u = dot(gradient(b01, c), f - vec2(0.0, 1.0));
      float b = mix(u, w, s.x);
      n[c] = mix(a, b, s.y);
    }
    sum += n * ratio;
    v *= 2.0;
    ratio *= 0.5;
  }
  vec4 c = clamp(sum * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  return vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a);
}

  // elsewhere; a texel of the noise alone keeps what its buffer held two frames before, the same noise, once both of

  bool bake = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE) || state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) != iResolution.xy;

  if (!inMelt(iChannel1, fragCoord)) discard;

// Every pixel, the player's last pass: the frost's scatter (feDisplacementMap at the nearest pixel), the lift of the
// edge and the speckle, each as Chromium computes them on 8-bit values; then the ground.
vec4 bytes(vec4 v) { return floor(clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) / 255.0; }

// whole numbers, so no compiler cancels the division the coordinate was made with (as SwiftShader's does), which the
// GPU's filter never sees

  vec4 c01 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a + ivec2(0, 1), ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 c11 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a + ivec2(1, 1), ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 x0 = c00 + f.x * (c10 - c00);
  vec4 x1 = c01 + f.x * (c11 - c01);

uvec2 readDouble(int i) {
  vec2 a = state(iChannel0, i), b = state(iChannel0, i + 1);
  return uvec2((uint(a.x) << 16) | uint(a.y), (uint(b.x) << 16) | uint(b.y));
}
// a double's half in a texel: two 16-bit pieces
vec2 pieces(uvec2 d, int part) {
  uint w = part == 0 ? d.x : d.y;
  return vec2(w >> 16, w & 0xffffu);
}
uvec2 hundredths(float x) { return dFromInt(int(floor(max(x, 0.0) * 100.0 + 0.5))); }
// Common's settings as one number, in two 16-bit halves
vec2 signature() {
  uint h = 2166136261u;
  for (int k = 0; k < 29; k++) {
    uint w = k < 24 ? COLORS[k] : k == 24 ? BG : floatBitsToUint(k == 25 ? SPEED : k == 26 ? FPS : k == 27 ? FROST : EASE);
    h = (h ^ w) * 16777619u;
  }
  return vec2(h >> 16, h & 0xffffu);
}

// the player's numbers for texel i of the first row
vec2 stateTexel(int i) {
  // the state is this text's, from an earlier frame of this run, for this canvas and these settings
  bool fresh = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  vec2 sign = signature();
  bool kept = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) == iResolution.xy && state(iChannel0, T_SIGN) == sign;
  if (i == T_MARK) return vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  if (i == T_STAMP) return iResolution.xy;
  if (i == T_SIGN) return sign;
  if (i == T_SEEN) return fresh ? vec2(-1.0) : state(iChannel0, T_STAMP);
  // a ball's two texels: its middle, and its radius
  bool ball = i >= T_BALLS, clock = i < T_LAYOUT;
  int which = ball ? (i - T_BALLS) / 2 : 0;
  // the layout and the weights are kept while the canvas and the settings are
  if (kept && !ball && !clock) return state(iChannel0, i);
  // the layout's doubles the places and the clock read: kept, or made again as JavaScript's doubles make them where
  // the canvas or the settings are new
  uvec2 made[10];
  if (kept) {
    for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) made[k] = readDouble(T_LAYOUT + 2 * k);
  } else {
    uvec2 R[159];
    for (int n = 0; n < 60; n++) R[n] = POOL[n];
    R[60] = dFromFloat(iResolution.x);
    R[61] = dFromFloat(iResolution.y);
    R[62] = hundredths(SPEED);
    R[63] = dFromInt(clamp(int(floor(FPS + 0.5)), 1, 120));
    R[64] = hundredths(FROST);
    R[65] = hundredths(EASE);
    R[66] = dFromInt(int(BG >> 24));
    R[67] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 16) & 255u));
    R[68] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 8) & 255u));
    R[69] = dFromInt(int(BG & 255u));
    R[70] = (BG & 255u) != 0u ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
    R[71] = MELT;
    R[72] = PAD;
    int to = !ball && !clock && i >= T_WEIGHTS ? 869 : 170;
    for (int pc = 0; pc < to; pc++) {
      uint ins = CODE[pc];
      uint op = ins & 31u;
      int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
      uvec2 a = R[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = R[int(ins >> 23)], r;
      if (op <= 4u) {
        // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
        uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
        bool whole = op >= 2u;
        bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
        uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
        r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
      }
      else if (op == 5u) r = dMul(a, b);
      else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
      else if (op <= 9u) {
        bool less = dLt(a, b);
        r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
      }
      else if (op == 10u) r = dZero(R[d]) ? b : a;
      else if (op == 11u) r = dFromFloat(dToFloat(a));
      else if (op == 12u) r = uvec2(a.x + (uint(dToInt(b)) << 20), a.y);
      else if (op == 13u) r = dFromFloat(sqrt(dToFloat(a)));
      else r = dDecimal(a, dToInt(b));
      R[d] = r;
    }
    if (!ball && !clock) {
      if (i < T_MELT) {
        int k = (i - T_LAYOUT) / 2;
        return pieces(R[k == 0 ? 73 : k == 1 ? 75 : k == 2 ? 76 : k == 3 ? 77 : k == 4 ? 78 : k == 5 ? 80 : k == 6 ? 81 : k == 7 ? 82 : k == 8 ? 83 : 84], (i - T_LAYOUT) % 2);
      }
      // the two registers this texel shows, as floats: picked first, so each conversion is written once
      int a = 85, b = -1;
      if (i == T_MELT) { a = 85; b = 86; }
      if (i == T_TAPS) { a = 87; b = 95; }
      if (i == T_REGION) { a = 88; b = 89; }
      if (i == T_REGION + 1) { a = 90; b = 91; }
      if (i == T_ORIGIN) { a = 101; b = 102; }
      if (i == T_TEXEL) { a = 103; b = 104; }
      if (i == T_SCATTER) { a = 105; b = 106; }
      if (i == T_K) { a = 107; b = -1; }
      if (i == T_GROUND) { a = 108; b = 109; }
      if (i == T_GROUND + 1) { a = 110; b = 111; }
      int w = i - T_WEIGHTS;
      if (w == 0) { a = 112; b = 113; }
      if (w == 1) { a = 114; b = 115; }
      if (w == 2) { a = 116; b = 117; }
      if (w == 3) { a = 118; b = 119; }
      if (w == 4) { a = 120; b = 121; }
      if (w == 5) { a = 122; b = 123; }
      if (w == 6) { a = 124; b = 125; }
      if (w == 7) { a = 126; b = 127; }
      if (w == 8) { a = 128; b = 129; }
      if (w == 9) { a = 130; b = 131; }
      return vec2(dToFloat(R[a]), b < 0 ? 0.0 : dToFloat(R[b]));
    }
    made[0] = R[73];
    made[1] = R[75];
    made[2] = R[76];
    made[3] = R[77];
    made[4] = R[78];
    made[5] = R[80];
    made[6] = R[81];
    made[7] = R[82];
    made[8] = R[83];
    made[9] = R[84];
  }

  float x = iTime * 240.0, grid = floor(x + 0.5);
  uvec2 CR[38];
  for (int n = 0; n < 9; n++) CR[n] = CPOOL[n];
  CR[9] = dFromInt(int(grid));
  CR[10] = dFromFloat(iTime);
  CR[11] = abs(x - grid) <= max(1e-4, grid * 2.4e-7) ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[12] = fresh ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[13] = kept ? D_ZERO : D_ONE;
  CR[14] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 0);
  CR[15] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 2);
  CR[16] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 4);
  CR[17] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 6);
  CR[19] = fresh ? dNeg(D_ONE) : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 8);
  CR[18] = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_FLAGS).y != 0.0 ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[20] = made[6];
  CR[21] = made[7];
  CR[22] = made[8];
  CR[23] = made[9];
  for (int pc = 0; pc < 73; pc++) {
    uint ins = CCODE[pc];
    uint op = ins & 31u;
    int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
    uvec2 a = CR[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = CR[int(ins >> 23)], r;
    if (op <= 4u) {
      // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
      uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
      bool whole = op >= 2u;
      bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
      uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
      r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
    }
    else if (op == 5u) r = dMul(a, b);
    else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
    else if (op <= 9u) {
      bool less = dLt(a, b);
      r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
    }
    else r = dZero(CR[d]) ? b : a;
    CR[d] = r;
  }
  if (i == T_FLAGS) return vec2(dToFloat(CR[30]), dToFloat(CR[28]));
  if (clock) {
    int k = (i - T_CLOCK) / 2;
    uvec2 d = CR[k == 0 ? 24 : k == 1 ? 25 : k == 2 ? 26 : k == 3 ? 27 : 29];
    return pieces(d, (i - T_CLOCK) % 2);

  if (kept && dZero(CR[30])) return state(iChannel0, i);

  vec3 p = placeFrame(fdouble(CR[31], Q), which, map);
  return (i - T_BALLS) % 2 == 0 ? p.xy : vec2(p.z, 0.0);
}

// feTurbulence fractalNoise, two octaves, as Ganesh computes it (the player's bake), at a pixel's middle
vec2 gradient(int index, int channel) {
  uint g = GRADIENTS[channel * 256 + (index & 255)];
  vec4 b = vec4(g & 255u, (g >> 8) & 255u, (g >> 16) & 255u, g >> 24) * BYTE;
  return (b.ga + b.rb * 0.00390625) * 2.0 - 1.0;
}
int selector(float x) {
  int at = int(x) & 255;
  uint l = (LATTICE[at >> 2] >> (8 * (at & 3))) & 255u;
  return l == 255u ? 256 : int(l);
}
vec4 turbulence(vec2 fragCoord) {
  // the design's map as the player's floats hold it: scaled to cover the canvas, centered. Its side times
  // iResolution.z, which is 1, so no compiler divides by a constant's reciprocal instead (as SwiftShader's does)
  vec2 R2 = iResolution.xy;
  float scale = max(R2.x, R2.y) / (500.0 * iResolution.z);
  vec2 offset = R2.x >= R2.y ? vec2(0.0, (R2.y - R2.x) * 0.5) : vec2((R2.x - R2.y) * 0.5, 0.0);
  vec2 v = ((fragCoord - offset) / scale + 0.5) * 0.75;
  vec4 sum = vec4(0.0);
  float ratio = 1.0;
  for (int octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
    vec2 f0 = floor(v);
    vec2 f = v - f0;
    vec2 s = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    int i = selector(f0.x);
    int j = selector(f0.x + 1.0);
    int y = int(f0.y);
    int b00 = i + y, b10 = j + y, b01 = i + y + 1, b11 = j + y + 1;
    vec4 n;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      float u = dot(gradient(b00, c), f);
      float w = dot(gradient(b10, c), f - vec2(1.0, 0.0));
      float a = mix(u, w, s.x);
      w = dot(gradient(b11, c), f - vec2(1.0));
      u = dot(gradient(b01, c), f - vec2(0.0, 1.0));
      float b = mix(u, w, s.x);
      n[c] = mix(a, b, s.y);
    }
    sum += n * ratio;
    v *= 2.0;
    ratio *= 0.5;
  }
  vec4 c = clamp(sum * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  return vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
  ivec2 p = ivec2(fragCoord);
  bool keeps = p.y == 0 && p.x < STATE;
  // the noise is baked where the state begins afresh or the canvas has a new size, and kept from the frame before
  // elsewhere; a texel of the noise alone keeps what its buffer held two frames before, the same noise, once both of
  // the buffer's two copies hold it: nothing to write
  bool bake = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE) || state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) != iResolution.xy;
  if (!keeps && !bake && state(iChannel0, T_SEEN) == iResolution.xy) discard;
  vec2 noise = texelFetch(iChannel0, p, 0).rg;
  if (bake) {
    // as an 8-bit texture keeps it: each channel to the nearest of 255 levels, ties to even
    vec4 k = roundEven(turbulence(fragCoord) * 255.0);
    noise = vec2(k.r + 256.0 * k.g, k.b + 256.0 * k.a);
  }
  // the player's numbers in the first row's texels, run only there: a loop the other texels never enter costs them
  // nothing on most GPUs
  vec2 numbers = vec2(0.0);
  for (int once = 0; once < (keeps ? 1 : 0); once++) numbers = stateTexel(p.x);
  fragColor = vec4(noise, numbers);
}

// feTurbulence's tables for a seed as Chromium's Skia builds them: the lattice selector (256 bytes) and the gradients,
// four channels of 256, each kept as two 16-bit values (256 x 4 RGBA texels, low bytes first).
function noiseTables(seed) {
  const M = 2147483647;
  let s = Math.trunc(seed);
  if (s <= 0) s = -(s % (M - 1)) + 1;
  if (s > M - 1) s = M - 1;
  const random = () => {
    s = 16807 * (s % 127773) - 2836 * Math.trunc(s / 127773);
    if (s <= 0) s += M;
    return s;
  };
  const lattice = new Uint8Array(256);
  const raw = new Uint16Array(4 * 512);
  for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      lattice[i] = i;
      raw[c * 512 + 2 * i] = random() % 512;
      raw[c * 512 + 2 * i + 1] = random() % 512;
    }
  }
  for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
    const k = lattice[i];
    const j = random() % 256;
    lattice[i] = lattice[j];
    lattice[j] = k;
  }
  const f = Math.fround;
  const gradients = new Uint8Array(4 * 256 * 4);
  for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
      const at = c * 512 + 2 * lattice[i];
      const gx = f((raw[at] - 256) / 256);
      const gy = f((raw[at + 1] - 256) / 256);
      const length = Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
      const o = 4 * (c * 256 + i);
      for (const [k, g] of [[0, length ? f(gx * (1 / length)) : 0], [2, length ? f(gy * (1 / length)) : 0]]) {
        const v = Math.floor(f(f(g + 1) * 32767.5) + 0.5);
        gradients[o + k] = v & 255;
        gradients[o + k + 1] = v >> 8;
      }
    }
  }
  return { lattice, gradients };
}

// The canvas: its device pixels as the browser lays it out, at most 8300000 of them, and the design's map
// to them, scaled to cover the box and centered: a design unit is (sx, sy) device pixels, its corner at (tx, ty).
function canvasOf(W, H, dpr, device) {
  const ew = Math.round(W * dpr);
  const eh = Math.round(H * dpr);
  const exact = device && Math.abs(device.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(device.h - eh) <= 2;
  let cw = exact && device ? device.w : ew;
  let ch = exact && device ? device.h : eh;
  const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(8300000 / Math.max(1, cw * ch)));
  cw = Math.max(1, Math.round(cw * fit));
  ch = Math.max(1, Math.round(ch * fit));
  return { w: cw, h: ch, kx: fit < 1 ? cw / W : dpr, ky: fit < 1 ? ch / H : dpr };
}
function mapOf(W, H, kx, ky) {
  const scale = Math.max(W / DESIGN, H / DESIGN);
  const x = (W - scale * DESIGN) / 2;
  const y = (H - scale * DESIGN) / 2;
  return { sx: scale * kx, sy: scale * ky, tx: x * kx, ty: y * ky };
}

// The melt: the filter region in whole device pixels, a small texture over what the canvas reads of it (each texel
// 6th of the blur's deviation), and the blur's taps and weights: a Gaussian truncated at three deviations.
const RADIUS = 19;
function meltOf(look, map, cw, ch, weights) {
  const { pad } = look;
  const region = [
    Math.floor(-pad * map.sx + map.tx + 0.5),
    Math.floor(-pad * map.sy + map.ty + 0.5),
    Math.floor((DESIGN + pad) * map.sx + map.tx + 0.5),
    Math.floor((DESIGN + pad) * map.sy + map.ty + 0.5)
  ];
  const sigma = look.melt * Math.max(map.sx, map.sy) * 1.004;
  const texel = Math.max(0.5, sigma / 6);
  const reach = Math.ceil(look.scatter * Math.max(map.sx, map.sy)) + 2;
  const x0 = Math.max(region[0], -reach);
  const y0 = Math.max(region[1], -reach);
  const x1 = Math.min(region[2], cw + reach);
  const y1 = Math.min(region[3], ch + reach);
  const margin = 3 * sigma + 2 * texel;
  const box = {
    x: x0 - margin,
    y: y0 - margin,
    texel,
    w: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.max(x1, x0) - x0 + 2 * margin) / texel)),
    h: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.max(y1, y0) - y0 + 2 * margin) / texel))
  };
  const s = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.25, (sigma / texel) ** 2 - 0.25));
  const taps = Math.min(RADIUS, Math.ceil(3 * (sigma / texel)));
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= RADIUS; i++) {
    weights[i] = i <= taps ? Math.exp(-(i * i) / (2 * s * s)) : 0;
    total += i ? 2 * weights[i] : weights[i];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i <= RADIUS; i++) weights[i] /= total;
  return { region, box, taps };
}

// Every ball's middle and radius in the design at a share f of the loop, at every stride from 0: each blob wanders
// and breathes, its ring turns, and each ball swings on its own circle.
function places(scene, f, out, stride) {
  let k = 0;
  for (const blob of scene.blobs) {
    const scale = (1 + ((1.12 - 0.88) / 2) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * blob.depth * f)) * blob.R;
    const x0 = blob.x + blob.wander[0].reach * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * blob.wander[0].laps * f);
    const y0 = blob.y + blob.wander[1].reach * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * blob.wander[1].laps * f);
    const turn = 2 * Math.PI * blob.spin * f;
    const cos = Math.cos(turn);
    const sin = Math.sin(turn);
    for (const b of blob.balls) {
      const swing = 2 * Math.PI * (b.phase + b.laps * f);
      const x = b.x + b.swing * Math.cos(swing);
      const y = b.y + b.swing * Math.sin(swing);
      out[k] = x0 + (b.ring ? x * cos - y * sin : x) * scale;
      out[k + 1] = y0 + (b.ring ? x * sin + y * cos : y) * scale;
      out[k + 2] = b.r * scale;
      k += stride;
    }
  }
}

// A frame rate kept on any screen: a frame is due once each 1/fps, a little early rather than a refresh late.
function createPace() {
  let last = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  return {
    due(now, fps) {
      if (!fps) return true;
      const every = 1000 / fps;
      if (now - last < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
      last = now - last > 2 * every ? now : last + every;
      return true;
    }
  };
}

// The ground, premultiplied: its color times its alpha, and its alpha; 0s for none.
function groundOf(bg) {
  if (!bg) return [0, 0, 0, 0];
  const alpha = bg.length === 9 ? parseInt(bg.slice(7), 16) / 255 : 1;
  return [...[1, 3, 5].map(i => (parseInt(bg.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255) * alpha), alpha];
}

// The drawing, WebGL 2, as the site's player draws it.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl2", {
  alpha: true,
  premultipliedAlpha: true,
  antialias: false,
  depth: false,
  stencil: false,
  preserveDrawingBuffer: false
});
if (gl) play();
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGL 2, which this browser does not have.";

function play() {
  const program = (vertex, fragment) => {
    const p = gl.createProgram();
    for (const [type, id] of [[gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertex], [gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragment]]) {
      const shader = gl.createShader(type);
      gl.shaderSource(shader, document.getElementById(id).textContent);
      gl.compileShader(shader);
      if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
      gl.attachShader(p, shader);
    }
    gl.linkProgram(p);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(p, gl.LINK_STATUS)) throw new Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(p));
    return p;
  };
  const texture = filter => {
    const t = gl.createTexture();
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, filter);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    return t;
  };

  // The scene, its colors and its numbers, and the noise's tables.
  const scene = blobScene();
  const look = blobFilter(scene);
  const n = scene.blobs.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.balls.length, 0);
  const data = new Float32Array(8 * n);
  let i = 0;
  for (const blob of scene.blobs)
    for (const b of blob.balls) {
      const [r, g, bl] = colorAt(b.at).map(v => v / 255);
      data[8 * i + 4] = r;
      data[8 * i + 5] = g;
      data[8 * i + 6] = bl;
      data[8 * i + 7] = 1;
      i++;
    }
  const ground = groundOf(BG);
  const { lattice, gradients } = noiseTables(look.seed);

  // What the GPU holds, made at the start and again where a lost context comes back.
  let dots, blur, bake, final, half, U, instances, dotsVao, fullVao, melt, noise, latticeTex, gradientTex;
  let baked = false;
  const make = () => {
    dots = program("dots-vs", "dots-fs");
    blur = program("cover-vs", "blur-fs");
    bake = program("cover-vs", "noise-fs");
    final = program("cover-vs", "final-fs");
    // the melt in half floats where they can be drawn into, so its blur adds no rounding of its own
    half = !!(gl.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_float") || gl.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_half_float"));
    const at = (p, names) => Object.fromEntries(names.map(n => [n, gl.getUniformLocation(p, n)]));
    U = {
      dots: at(dots, ["size"]),
      blur: at(blur, ["source", "step_by", "taps", "weights"]),
      bake: at(bake, ["lattice", "gradients", "scale", "offset", "frequency"]),
      final: at(final, ["melt", "noise", "canvas_h", "melt_origin", "melt_texel", "region", "scatter", "frosted", "lift", "gray", "k", "ground"])
    };
    const quad = gl.createBuffer();
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    instances = gl.createBuffer();
    dotsVao = gl.createVertexArray();
    gl.bindVertexArray(dotsVao);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, instances);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 0);
    gl.vertexAttribDivisor(1, 1);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 16);
    gl.vertexAttribDivisor(2, 1);
    fullVao = gl.createVertexArray();
    gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, quad);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.bindVertexArray(null);
    melt = [0, 1].map(() => ({ texture: texture(gl.LINEAR), frame: gl.createFramebuffer() }));
    noise = { texture: texture(gl.NEAREST), frame: gl.createFramebuffer() };
    latticeTex = texture(gl.NEAREST);
    gradientTex = texture(gl.NEAREST);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, instances);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, data.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
    gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, latticeTex);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.R8UI, 256, 1, 0, gl.RED_INTEGER, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, lattice);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gradientTex);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, 256, 4, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, gradients);
    baked = false;
  };
  make();

  // The canvas at its size: the design's map, the filter region, the melt's texture and the blur's weights.
  let map = { sx: 1, sy: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
  let canvasSize = { w: 1, h: 1 };
  let meltBox = { x: 0, y: 0, texel: 1, w: 1, h: 1 };
  let regionPx = [0, 0, 1, 1];
  const weights = new Float32Array(RADIUS + 1);
  let taps = 0;
  const resize = () => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return false;
    const W = Math.max(1, rect.width);
    const H = Math.max(1, rect.height);
    const { w: cw, h: ch, kx, ky } = canvasOf(W, H, devicePixelRatio || 1, device);
    if (canvas.width !== cw || canvas.height !== ch) {
      canvas.width = cw;
      canvas.height = ch;
    }
    if (canvasSize.w !== cw || canvasSize.h !== ch) baked = false;
    canvasSize = { w: cw, h: ch };
    const next = mapOf(W, H, kx, ky);
    if (next.sx !== map.sx || next.sy !== map.sy || next.tx !== map.tx || next.ty !== map.ty) baked = false;
    map = next;
    const melted = meltOf(look, map, cw, ch, weights);
    regionPx = melted.region;
    meltBox = melted.box;
    taps = melted.taps;
    const format = half ? gl.RGBA16F : gl.RGBA8;
    const type = half ? gl.HALF_FLOAT : gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE;
    for (const { texture: t, frame } of melt) {
      gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t);
      gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, format, meltBox.w, meltBox.h, 0, gl.RGBA, type, null);
      gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, frame);
      gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, t, 0);
    }
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    return true;
  };

  // The frost's noise at every device pixel, once a size.
  const bakeNoise = () => {
    const u = U.bake;
    const { w, h } = canvasSize;
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, noise.texture);
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA8, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, noise.frame);
    gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, noise.texture, 0);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, w, h);
    gl.useProgram(bake);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, latticeTex);
    gl.uniform1i(u.lattice, 0);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gradientTex);
    gl.uniform1i(u.gradients, 1);
    gl.uniform2f(u.scale, map.sx, map.sy);
    gl.uniform2f(u.offset, map.tx, map.ty);
    gl.uniform1f(u.frequency, look.frequency);
    gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    baked = true;
  };

  // A frame at a share f of the loop.
  const draw = f => {
    if (look.noise && !baked) bakeNoise();
    // the balls, small: each a quad its own color covers, painted in the scene's order
    const { texel } = meltBox;
    places(scene, f, data, 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8 * n; i += 8) {
      data[i] = (data[i] * map.sx + map.tx - meltBox.x) / texel;
      data[i + 1] = (data[i + 1] * map.sy + map.ty - meltBox.y) / texel;
      data[i + 2] = (data[i + 2] * map.sx) / texel;
    }
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, instances);
    gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, data);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, melt[0].frame);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, meltBox.w, meltBox.h);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);
    gl.useProgram(dots);
    gl.uniform2f(U.dots.size, meltBox.w, meltBox.h);
    gl.bindVertexArray(dotsVao);
    gl.drawArraysInstanced(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4, n);
    gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
    // the melt: across, then down
    gl.useProgram(blur);
    gl.bindVertexArray(fullVao);
    gl.uniform1i(U.blur.taps, taps);
    gl.uniform1fv(U.blur.weights, weights);
    gl.uniform1i(U.blur.source, 0);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, melt[1].frame);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, melt[0].texture);
    gl.uniform2i(U.blur.step_by, 1, 0);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, melt[0].frame);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, melt[1].texture);
    gl.uniform2i(U.blur.step_by, 0, 1);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    // every pixel: the frost's scatter, the lift of the edge, the speckle, the ground
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
    gl.viewport(0, 0, canvasSize.w, canvasSize.h);
    gl.useProgram(final);
    const u = U.final;
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, melt[0].texture);
    gl.uniform1i(u.melt, 0);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, noise.texture);
    gl.uniform1i(u.noise, 1);
    gl.uniform1f(u.canvas_h, canvasSize.h);
    gl.uniform2f(u.melt_origin, meltBox.x, meltBox.y);
    gl.uniform1f(u.melt_texel, texel);
    gl.uniform4f(u.region, regionPx[0], regionPx[1], regionPx[2], regionPx[3]);
    gl.uniform2f(u.scatter, look.scatter * map.sx, look.scatter * map.sy);
    gl.uniform1i(u.frosted, look.noise ? 1 : 0);
    gl.uniform2f(u.lift, look.slope, look.lift);
    gl.uniform2f(u.gray, look.contrast, look.gray);
    gl.uniform2f(u.k, look.k1, look.k2);
    gl.uniform4f(u.ground, ground[0], ground[1], ground[2], ground[3]);
    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, 0, 4);
    gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
  };
  // A lost context stops the clock; where the browser gives it back, everything the GPU held is made again and the
  // frame drawn at once.
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextrestored", () => {
    make();
    if (resize()) {
      changed = true;
      wake();
    }
  });

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, easing in from rest over EASE seconds. The first
  // frame draws at once; a reader who asks for less motion sees it held.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let shown = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let first = true;
  let drawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let settle = 0;
  let sized = false;
  const moving = () => shown && !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && SPEED > 0;
  const pace = createPace();
  const share = () => (reduced.matches ? 0 : (t / LOOP) % 1);
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (!sized) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!moving()) warm = 0;
    else if (!first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    const at = share();
    if (changed || (at !== drawn && pace.due(now, FPS))) {
      draw(at);
      drawn = at;
      changed = false;
    }
    first = false;
    if (moving()) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    if (!raf) {
      last = performance.now();
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
  };

  // The canvas's size in device pixels, as the browser lays it out; a later size settles 150 ms first.
  let device = null;
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    device = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    const apply = () => {
      if (!resize() && !sized) return;
      sized = true;
      changed = true;
      wake();
    };
    if (!sized) apply();
    else settle = setTimeout(apply, 150);
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    shown = entries.some(e => e.isIntersecting);
    if (shown) wake();
  }).observe(canvas);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", wake);
}
</script>

// Fixed point: signed 64-bit integers as two words, high first, with F bits of fraction. No branch: a compiler that
// inlines every call (SwiftShader's and D3D's do) gets straight code it compiles quickly.
// a, or its negative where s is 1
uvec2 fsign(uvec2 a, uint s) { return add64(a ^ uvec2(0u - s), uvec2(0u, s)); }

  // the 128-bit product's words, w0 the lowest
  uint w0 = p00.y;
  uint w1 = p00.x + p01.y;
  uint c1 = uint(w1 < p00.x);
  w1 += p10.y;
  c1 += uint(w1 < p10.y);
  uint w2 = p01.x + p10.x;
  uint c2 = uint(w2 < p01.x);
  w2 += p11.y;
  c2 += uint(w2 < p11.y);
  w2 += c1;
  c2 += uint(w2 < c1);
  uint w3 = p11.x + c2;
  // plus half of the last bit kept, then bits F to F + 63
  uvec2 low = add64(uvec2(w1, w0), shl64(uvec2(0u, 1u), F - 1));
  uvec2 high = add64(uvec2(w3, w2), uvec2(0u, lt64(low, uvec2(w1, w0))));
  return fsign(shl64(high, 64 - F) | shr64(low, F), (a.x ^ b.x) >> 31);

uvec2 fdouble(uvec2 d, int F) {

float ftofloat(uvec2 a, int F) {

  uint k = kept.y;

const ivec3 PLACE_SINES = ivec3(22, 2, 23), PLACE_NEGATIVES = ivec3(24, 25, 26);
const ivec3 PLACE_COSINES = ivec3(0, 1, 21);
// the register of the sine of laps laps a loop, the negative's for negative laps
int sineOf(int laps) {
  int k = abs(laps) - 1;
  return laps > 0 ? PLACE_SINES[k] : PLACE_NEGATIVES[k];
}
// blobPlaces for ball `which` at the share `at`, then the player's draw into the melt's texels, as floats; made
// holds the layout's doubles: the map (sx, sy, tx, ty), the melt's corner and the texel's inverse
vec3 placeFrame(uvec2 at, int which, uvec2 made[7]) {
  uvec2 V[28];
  // the share's nearest quarter turn, the share less it, and the turn's cosine and sine
  int quarter = int(shr64(add64(shl64(at, 2), shl64(uvec2(0u, 1u), Q - 1)), Q).y);
  int turn = quarter & 3;
  V[0] = sub64(at, shl64(uvec2(0u, uint(quarter)), Q - 2));
  V[1] = turn == 0 ? Q_ONE : turn == 2 ? Q_MINUS_ONE : uvec2(0u);
  V[2] = turn == 1 ? Q_ONE : turn == 3 ? Q_MINUS_ONE : uvec2(0u);
  int blob = which / 8;
  for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) V[3 + k] = BLOBS[blob * 5 + k];
  for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) V[8 + k] = BALLS[which * 6 + k];
  // the map, the melt's corner and the texel's inverse at 48 bits
  for (int k = 0; k < 7; k++) V[14 + k] = fdouble(made[k], 48);
  // what the ball's laps choose: sines by its blob's laps in depth, across and down, the cosine and sine of its own
  // laps, the ring's turn, and its place turned with the ring where it rides one
  ivec4 laps = BLOB_LAPS[blob];
  ivec2 own = BALL_LAPS[which];
  ivec4 to0 = ivec4(sineOf(laps.z), sineOf(laps.x), sineOf(laps.y), PLACE_COSINES[abs(own.x) - 1]);
  ivec4 to1 = ivec4(sineOf(own.x), laps.w < 0 ? 24 : 22, own.y != 0 ? 6 : 2, own.y != 0 ? 0 : 1);
  for (int pc = 0; pc < 97; pc++) {
    uint ins = PLACE_CODE[pc];
    uint op = ins & 7u;
    int a = int((ins >> 10) & 127u), b = int(ins >> 17);
    a = a < 112 ? a : a < 116 ? to0[(a - 112) & 3] : to1[(a - 116) & 3];
    b = b < 112 ? b : b < 116 ? to0[(b - 112) & 3] : to1[(b - 116) & 3];
    uvec2 x = a < 64 ? V[min(a, 27)] : PLACE_K[clamp(a - 64, 0, 20)];
    uvec2 y = b < 64 ? V[min(b, 27)] : PLACE_K[clamp(b - 64, 0, 20)];
    // every operation, then the one the step names: no branch
    uvec2 product = fmul(x, y, op == 0u ? Q : 48), sum = add64(x, y), difference = sub64(x, y);
    float f = ftofloat(x, op == 4u ? Q : 48);
    uvec2 back = ffloat(f, 48);
    V[int((ins >> 3) & 127u)] = op < 2u ? product : op == 2u ? sum : op == 3u ? difference : op == 4u ? back : uvec2(floatBitsToUint(f), 0u);
  }
  return vec3(uintBitsToFloat(V[2].x), uintBitsToFloat(V[0].x), uintBitsToFloat(V[1].x));
}

vec2 stateTexel(int i) {

// feTurbulence fractalNoise, two octaves, as Ganesh computes it (the player's bake), at a pixel's middle
vec2 gradient(int index, int channel) {
  uint g = GRADIENTS[channel * 256 + (index & 255)];
  vec4 b = vec4(g & 255u, (g >> 8) & 255u, (g >> 16) & 255u, g >> 24) * BYTE;
  return (b.ga + b.rb * 0.00390625) * 2.0 - 1.0;
}
int selector(float x) {
  int at = int(x) & 255;
  uint l = (LATTICE[at >> 2] >> (8 * (at & 3))) & 255u;
  return l == 255u ? 256 : int(l);
}
vec4 turbulence(vec2 fragCoord) {
  // the design's map as the player's floats hold it: scaled to cover the canvas, centered. Its side times
  // iResolution.z, which is 1, so no compiler divides by a constant's reciprocal instead (as SwiftShader's does)
  vec2 R2 = iResolution.xy;
  float scale = max(R2.x, R2.y) / (500.0 * iResolution.z);
  vec2 offset = R2.x >= R2.y ? vec2(0.0, (R2.y - R2.x) * 0.5) : vec2((R2.x - R2.y) * 0.5, 0.0);
  vec2 v = ((fragCoord - offset) / scale + 0.5) * 0.75;
  vec4 sum = vec4(0.0);
  float ratio = 1.0;
  for (int octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
    vec2 f0 = floor(v);
    vec2 f = v - f0;
    vec2 s = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    int i = selector(f0.x);
    int j = selector(f0.x + 1.0);
    int y = int(f0.y);
    int b00 = i + y, b10 = j + y, b01 = i + y + 1, b11 = j + y + 1;
    vec4 n;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      float u = dot(gradient(b00, c), f);
      float w = dot(gradient(b10, c), f - vec2(1.0, 0.0));
      float a = mix(u, w, s.x);
      w = dot(gradient(b11, c), f - vec2(1.0));
      u = dot(gradient(b01, c), f - vec2(0.0, 1.0));
      float b = mix(u, w, s.x);
      n[c] = mix(a, b, s.y);
    }
    sum += n * ratio;
    v *= 2.0;
    ratio *= 0.5;
  }
  vec4 c = clamp(sum * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  return vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a);
}

      raw[c * 512 + 2 * i + 1] = random() % 512;

// The melt: the filter region in whole device pixels, a small texture over what the canvas reads of it (each texel
// 6th of the blur's deviation), and the blur's taps and weights: a Gaussian truncated at three deviations.
const RADIUS = 19;

    Math.floor(-pad * map.sx + map.tx + 0.5),
    Math.floor(-pad * map.sy + map.ty + 0.5),
    Math.floor((DESIGN + pad) * map.sx + map.tx + 0.5),
    Math.floor((DESIGN + pad) * map.sy + map.ty + 0.5)

    x: x0 - margin,
    y: y0 - margin,
    texel,
    w: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.max(x1, x0) - x0 + 2 * margin) / texel)),
    h: Math.max(1, Math.ceil((Math.max(y1, y0) - y0 + 2 * margin) / texel))

// Every ball's middle and radius in the design at a share f of the loop, at every stride from 0: each blob wanders

// Doubles as their two words, high first: JavaScript's arithmetic, rounded to nearest even, with no branch.
// c is 1 or 0: x where it is 1, y where 0.
uvec2 sel(uint c, uvec2 x, uvec2 y) {
  uvec2 m = uvec2(0u - c);
  return (x & m) | (y & ~m);
}
int seli(uint c, int x, int y) { return int((uint(x) & (0u - c)) | (uint(y) & ~(0u - c))); }
uvec2 add64(uvec2 a, uvec2 b) {
  uint lo = a.y + b.y;
  return uvec2(a.x + b.x + uint(lo < a.y), lo);

uvec2 readDouble(int i) {
  vec2 a = state(iChannel0, i), b = state(iChannel0, i + 1);

    h = (h ^ w) * 16777619u;

// the player's numbers for texel i of the first row
vec2 stateTexel(int i) {

  bool fresh = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  vec2 sign = signature();
  bool kept = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) == iResolution.xy && state(iChannel0, T_SIGN) == sign;
  if (i == T_MARK) return vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  if (i == T_STAMP) return iResolution.xy;
  if (i == T_SIGN) return sign;
  if (i == T_SEEN) return fresh ? vec2(-1.0) : state(iChannel0, T_STAMP);

  bool ball = i >= T_BALLS, clock = i < T_LAYOUT;
  int which = ball ? (i - T_BALLS) / 2 : 0;

  if (kept && !ball && !clock) return state(iChannel0, i);

  // the canvas or the settings are new

    uvec2 R[159];
    for (int n = 0; n < 60; n++) R[n] = POOL[n];
    R[60] = dFromFloat(iResolution.x);
    R[61] = dFromFloat(iResolution.y);
    R[62] = hundredths(SPEED);
    R[63] = dFromInt(clamp(int(floor(FPS + 0.5)), 1, 120));
    R[64] = hundredths(FROST);
    R[65] = hundredths(EASE);
    R[66] = dFromInt(int(BG >> 24));
    R[67] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 16) & 255u));
    R[68] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 8) & 255u));
    R[69] = dFromInt(int(BG & 255u));
    R[70] = (BG & 255u) != 0u ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
    R[71] = MELT;
    R[72] = PAD;
    int to = !ball && !clock && i >= T_WEIGHTS ? 869 : 170;
    for (int pc = 0; pc < to; pc++) {
      uint ins = CODE[pc];
      uint op = ins & 31u;
      int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
      uvec2 a = R[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = R[int(ins >> 23)], r;
      if (op <= 4u) {
        // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
        uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
        bool whole = op >= 2u;
        bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
        uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
        r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
      }

      else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
      else if (op <= 9u) {

        r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
      }

      else if (op == 11u) r = dFromFloat(dToFloat(a));

      else if (op == 13u) r = dFromFloat(sqrt(dToFloat(a)));

        int k = (i - T_LAYOUT) / 2;
        return pieces(R[k == 0 ? 73 : k == 1 ? 75 : k == 2 ? 76 : k == 3 ? 77 : k == 4 ? 78 : k == 5 ? 80 : k == 6 ? 81 : k == 7 ? 82 : k == 8 ? 83 : 84], (i - T_LAYOUT) % 2);

      int a = 85, b = -1;

      if (i == T_REGION) { a = 88; b = 89; }
      if (i == T_REGION + 1) { a = 90; b = 91; }
      if (i == T_ORIGIN) { a = 101; b = 102; }
      if (i == T_TEXEL) { a = 103; b = 104; }
      if (i == T_SCATTER) { a = 105; b = 106; }
      if (i == T_K) { a = 107; b = -1; }

      if (w == 1) { a = 114; b = 115; }
      if (w == 2) { a = 116; b = 117; }
      if (w == 3) { a = 118; b = 119; }
      if (w == 4) { a = 120; b = 121; }
      if (w == 5) { a = 122; b = 123; }
      if (w == 6) { a = 124; b = 125; }
      if (w == 7) { a = 126; b = 127; }
      if (w == 8) { a = 128; b = 129; }

    made[1] = R[75];
    made[2] = R[76];
    made[3] = R[77];
    made[4] = R[78];
    made[5] = R[80];
    made[6] = R[81];
    made[7] = R[82];
    made[8] = R[83];
    made[9] = R[84];

  float x = iTime * 240.0, grid = floor(x + 0.5);

  CR[10] = dFromFloat(iTime);
  CR[11] = abs(x - grid) <= max(1e-4, grid * 2.4e-7) ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[12] = fresh ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[13] = kept ? D_ZERO : D_ONE;
  CR[14] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 0);
  CR[15] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 2);
  CR[16] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 4);
  CR[17] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 6);
  CR[19] = fresh ? dNeg(D_ONE) : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 8);
  CR[18] = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_FLAGS).y != 0.0 ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[20] = made[6];
  CR[21] = made[7];
  CR[22] = made[8];
  CR[23] = made[9];
  for (int pc = 0; pc < 73; pc++) {
    uint ins = CCODE[pc];
    uint op = ins & 31u;
    int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
    uvec2 a = CR[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = CR[int(ins >> 23)], r;
    if (op <= 4u) {
      // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
      uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
      bool whole = op >= 2u;
      bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
      uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
      r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
    }
    else if (op == 5u) r = dMul(a, b);
    else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
    else if (op <= 9u) {
      bool less = dLt(a, b);
      r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
    }
    else r = dZero(CR[d]) ? b : a;
    CR[d] = r;
  }

    int k = (i - T_CLOCK) / 2;

    return pieces(d, (i - T_CLOCK) % 2);

  if (kept && dZero(CR[30])) return state(iChannel0, i);

  vec3 p = placeFrame(fdouble(CR[31], Q), which, map);
  return (i - T_BALLS) % 2 == 0 ? p.xy : vec2(p.z, 0.0);
}

// feTurbulence fractalNoise, two octaves, as Ganesh computes it (the player's bake), at a pixel's middle
vec2 gradient(int index, int channel) {
  uint g = GRADIENTS[channel * 256 + (index & 255)];
  vec4 b = vec4(g & 255u, (g >> 8) & 255u, (g >> 16) & 255u, g >> 24) * BYTE;
  return (b.ga + b.rb * 0.00390625) * 2.0 - 1.0;
}
int selector(float x) {
  int at = int(x) & 255;

vec4 turbulence(vec2 fragCoord) {

  // iResolution.z, which is 1, so no compiler divides by a constant's reciprocal instead (as SwiftShader's does)
  vec2 R2 = iResolution.xy;
  float scale = max(R2.x, R2.y) / (500.0 * iResolution.z);
  vec2 offset = R2.x >= R2.y ? vec2(0.0, (R2.y - R2.x) * 0.5) : vec2((R2.x - R2.y) * 0.5, 0.0);
  vec2 v = ((fragCoord - offset) / scale + 0.5) * 0.75;
  vec4 sum = vec4(0.0);
  float ratio = 1.0;
  for (int octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
    vec2 f0 = floor(v);
    vec2 f = v - f0;
    vec2 s = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    int i = selector(f0.x);
    int j = selector(f0.x + 1.0);
    int y = int(f0.y);
    int b00 = i + y, b10 = j + y, b01 = i + y + 1, b11 = j + y + 1;
    vec4 n;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      float u = dot(gradient(b00, c), f);
      float w = dot(gradient(b10, c), f - vec2(1.0, 0.0));
      float a = mix(u, w, s.x);
      w = dot(gradient(b11, c), f - vec2(1.0));
      u = dot(gradient(b01, c), f - vec2(0.0, 1.0));
      float b = mix(u, w, s.x);
      n[c] = mix(a, b, s.y);
    }
    sum += n * ratio;
    v *= 2.0;
    ratio *= 0.5;
  }
  vec4 c = clamp(sum * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  return vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {

  // elsewhere; a texel of the noise alone keeps what its buffer held two frames before, the same noise, once both of
  // the buffer's two copies hold it: nothing to write
  bool bake = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE) || state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) != iResolution.xy;
  if (!keeps && !bake && state(iChannel0, T_SEEN) == iResolution.xy) discard;

    vec4 k = roundEven(turbulence(fragCoord) * 255.0);

// Every pixel, the player's last pass: the frost's scatter (feDisplacementMap at the nearest pixel), the lift of the
// edge and the speckle, each as Chromium computes them on 8-bit values; then the ground.
vec4 bytes(vec4 v) { return floor(clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0) * 255.0 + 0.5) / 255.0; }

// whole numbers, so no compiler cancels the division the coordinate was made with (as SwiftShader's does), which the
// GPU's filter never sees
vec4 meltAt(vec2 uv, ivec2 size) {

  vec4 c00 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a, ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 c10 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a + ivec2(1, 0), ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 c01 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a + ivec2(0, 1), ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 c11 = texelFetch(iChannel0, clamp(a + ivec2(1, 1), ivec2(0), top), 0);
  vec4 x0 = c00 + f.x * (c10 - c00);
  vec4 x1 = c01 + f.x * (c11 - c01);
  return x0 + f.y * (x1 - x0);

uvec2 readDouble(int i) {
  vec2 a = state(iChannel0, i), b = state(iChannel0, i + 1);
  return uvec2((uint(a.x) << 16) | uint(a.y), (uint(b.x) << 16) | uint(b.y));
}
// a double's half in a texel: two 16-bit pieces
vec2 pieces(uvec2 d, int part) {
  uint w = part == 0 ? d.x : d.y;
  return vec2(w >> 16, w & 0xffffu);
}
uvec2 hundredths(float x) { return dFromInt(int(floor(max(x, 0.0) * 100.0 + 0.5))); }
// Common's settings as one number, in two 16-bit halves
vec2 signature() {
  uint h = 2166136261u;
  for (int k = 0; k < 29; k++) {
    uint w = k < 24 ? COLORS[k] : k == 24 ? BG : floatBitsToUint(k == 25 ? SPEED : k == 26 ? FPS : k == 27 ? FROST : EASE);
    h = (h ^ w) * 16777619u;
  }
  return vec2(h >> 16, h & 0xffffu);
}

// the player's numbers for texel i of the first row
vec2 stateTexel(int i) {
  // the state is this text's, from an earlier frame of this run, for this canvas and these settings
  bool fresh = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  vec2 sign = signature();
  bool kept = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) == iResolution.xy && state(iChannel0, T_SIGN) == sign;
  if (i == T_MARK) return vec2(MAGIC, SCENE);
  if (i == T_STAMP) return iResolution.xy;
  if (i == T_SIGN) return sign;
  if (i == T_SEEN) return fresh ? vec2(-1.0) : state(iChannel0, T_STAMP);
  // a ball's two texels: its middle, and its radius
  bool ball = i >= T_BALLS, clock = i < T_LAYOUT;
  int which = ball ? (i - T_BALLS) / 2 : 0;
  // the layout and the weights are kept while the canvas and the settings are
  if (kept && !ball && !clock) return state(iChannel0, i);
  // the layout's doubles the places and the clock read: kept, or made again as JavaScript's doubles make them where
  // the canvas or the settings are new
  uvec2 made[10];
  if (kept) {
    for (int k = 0; k < 10; k++) made[k] = readDouble(T_LAYOUT + 2 * k);
  } else {
    uvec2 R[159];
    for (int n = 0; n < 60; n++) R[n] = POOL[n];
    R[60] = dFromFloat(iResolution.x);
    R[61] = dFromFloat(iResolution.y);
    R[62] = hundredths(SPEED);
    R[63] = dFromInt(clamp(int(floor(FPS + 0.5)), 1, 120));
    R[64] = hundredths(FROST);
    R[65] = hundredths(EASE);
    R[66] = dFromInt(int(BG >> 24));
    R[67] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 16) & 255u));
    R[68] = dFromInt(int((BG >> 8) & 255u));
    R[69] = dFromInt(int(BG & 255u));
    R[70] = (BG & 255u) != 0u ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
    R[71] = MELT;
    R[72] = PAD;
    int to = !ball && !clock && i >= T_WEIGHTS ? 869 : 170;
    for (int pc = 0; pc < to; pc++) {
      uint ins = CODE[pc];
      uint op = ins & 31u;
      int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
      uvec2 a = R[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = R[int(ins >> 23)], r;
      if (op <= 4u) {
        // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
        uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
        bool whole = op >= 2u;
        bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
        uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
        r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
      }
      else if (op == 5u) r = dMul(a, b);
      else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
      else if (op <= 9u) {
        bool less = dLt(a, b);
        r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
      }
      else if (op == 10u) r = dZero(R[d]) ? b : a;
      else if (op == 11u) r = dFromFloat(dToFloat(a));
      else if (op == 12u) r = uvec2(a.x + (uint(dToInt(b)) << 20), a.y);
      else if (op == 13u) r = dFromFloat(sqrt(dToFloat(a)));
      else r = dDecimal(a, dToInt(b));
      R[d] = r;
    }
    if (!ball && !clock) {
      if (i < T_MELT) {
        int k = (i - T_LAYOUT) / 2;
        return pieces(R[k == 0 ? 73 : k == 1 ? 75 : k == 2 ? 76 : k == 3 ? 77 : k == 4 ? 78 : k == 5 ? 80 : k == 6 ? 81 : k == 7 ? 82 : k == 8 ? 83 : 84], (i - T_LAYOUT) % 2);
      }
      // the two registers this texel shows, as floats: picked first, so each conversion is written once
      int a = 85, b = -1;
      if (i == T_MELT) { a = 85; b = 86; }
      if (i == T_TAPS) { a = 87; b = 95; }
      if (i == T_REGION) { a = 88; b = 89; }
      if (i == T_REGION + 1) { a = 90; b = 91; }
      if (i == T_ORIGIN) { a = 101; b = 102; }
      if (i == T_TEXEL) { a = 103; b = 104; }
      if (i == T_SCATTER) { a = 105; b = 106; }
      if (i == T_K) { a = 107; b = -1; }
      if (i == T_GROUND) { a = 108; b = 109; }
      if (i == T_GROUND + 1) { a = 110; b = 111; }
      int w = i - T_WEIGHTS;
      if (w == 0) { a = 112; b = 113; }
      if (w == 1) { a = 114; b = 115; }
      if (w == 2) { a = 116; b = 117; }
      if (w == 3) { a = 118; b = 119; }
      if (w == 4) { a = 120; b = 121; }
      if (w == 5) { a = 122; b = 123; }
      if (w == 6) { a = 124; b = 125; }
      if (w == 7) { a = 126; b = 127; }
      if (w == 8) { a = 128; b = 129; }
      if (w == 9) { a = 130; b = 131; }
      return vec2(dToFloat(R[a]), b < 0 ? 0.0 : dToFloat(R[b]));
    }
    made[0] = R[73];
    made[1] = R[75];
    made[2] = R[76];
    made[3] = R[77];
    made[4] = R[78];
    made[5] = R[80];
    made[6] = R[81];
    made[7] = R[82];
    made[8] = R[83];
    made[9] = R[84];
  }

  float x = iTime * 240.0, grid = floor(x + 0.5);
  uvec2 CR[38];
  for (int n = 0; n < 9; n++) CR[n] = CPOOL[n];
  CR[9] = dFromInt(int(grid));
  CR[10] = dFromFloat(iTime);
  CR[11] = abs(x - grid) <= max(1e-4, grid * 2.4e-7) ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[12] = fresh ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[13] = kept ? D_ZERO : D_ONE;
  CR[14] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 0);
  CR[15] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 2);
  CR[16] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 4);
  CR[17] = fresh ? D_ZERO : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 6);
  CR[19] = fresh ? dNeg(D_ONE) : readDouble(T_CLOCK + 8);
  CR[18] = !fresh && state(iChannel0, T_FLAGS).y != 0.0 ? D_ONE : D_ZERO;
  CR[20] = made[6];
  CR[21] = made[7];
  CR[22] = made[8];
  CR[23] = made[9];
  for (int pc = 0; pc < 73; pc++) {
    uint ins = CCODE[pc];
    uint op = ins & 31u;
    int d = int((ins >> 5) & 511u);
    uvec2 a = CR[int((ins >> 14) & 511u)], b = CR[int(ins >> 23)], r;
    if (op <= 4u) {
      // add, sub, trunc, floor, ceil: one addition, of the integer toward zero and a step where one is due
      uvec2 t = dTrunc(a);
      bool whole = op >= 2u;
      bool step = t != a && ((op == 3u && dSign(a) == 1u) || (op == 4u && dSign(a) == 0u));
      uvec2 y = whole ? (step ? (op == 3u ? dNeg(D_ONE) : D_ONE) : uvec2(0x80000000u, 0u)) : op == 1u ? dNeg(b) : b;
      r = dAdd(whole ? t : a, y);
    }
    else if (op == 5u) r = dMul(a, b);
    else if (op == 6u) r = dDiv(a, b);
    else if (op <= 9u) {
      bool less = dLt(a, b);
      r = op == 7u ? (dLt(b, a) ? b : a) : op == 8u ? (less ? b : a) : (less ? D_ONE : D_ZERO);
    }
    else r = dZero(CR[d]) ? b : a;
    CR[d] = r;
  }

  if (clock) {
    int k = (i - T_CLOCK) / 2;
    uvec2 d = CR[k == 0 ? 24 : k == 1 ? 25 : k == 2 ? 26 : k == 3 ? 27 : 29];
    return pieces(d, (i - T_CLOCK) % 2);

  if (kept && dZero(CR[30])) return state(iChannel0, i);
  uvec2 map[7] = uvec2[](made[0], made[0], made[1], made[2], made[3], made[4], made[5]);
  vec3 p = placeFrame(fdouble(CR[31], Q), which, map);
  return (i - T_BALLS) % 2 == 0 ? p.xy : vec2(p.z, 0.0);
}

// feTurbulence fractalNoise, two octaves, as Ganesh computes it (the player's bake), at a pixel's middle
vec2 gradient(int index, int channel) {
  uint g = GRADIENTS[channel * 256 + (index & 255)];
  vec4 b = vec4(g & 255u, (g >> 8) & 255u, (g >> 16) & 255u, g >> 24) * BYTE;
  return (b.ga + b.rb * 0.00390625) * 2.0 - 1.0;
}
int selector(float x) {
  int at = int(x) & 255;
  uint l = (LATTICE[at >> 2] >> (8 * (at & 3))) & 255u;
  return l == 255u ? 256 : int(l);
}
vec4 turbulence(vec2 fragCoord) {
  // the design's map as the player's floats hold it: scaled to cover the canvas, centered. Its side times
  // iResolution.z, which is 1, so no compiler divides by a constant's reciprocal instead (as SwiftShader's does)
  vec2 R2 = iResolution.xy;
  float scale = max(R2.x, R2.y) / (500.0 * iResolution.z);
  vec2 offset = R2.x >= R2.y ? vec2(0.0, (R2.y - R2.x) * 0.5) : vec2((R2.x - R2.y) * 0.5, 0.0);
  vec2 v = ((fragCoord - offset) / scale + 0.5) * 0.75;
  vec4 sum = vec4(0.0);
  float ratio = 1.0;
  for (int octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
    vec2 f0 = floor(v);
    vec2 f = v - f0;
    vec2 s = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    int i = selector(f0.x);
    int j = selector(f0.x + 1.0);
    int y = int(f0.y);
    int b00 = i + y, b10 = j + y, b01 = i + y + 1, b11 = j + y + 1;
    vec4 n;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
      float u = dot(gradient(b00, c), f);
      float w = dot(gradient(b10, c), f - vec2(1.0, 0.0));
      float a = mix(u, w, s.x);
      w = dot(gradient(b11, c), f - vec2(1.0));
      u = dot(gradient(b01, c), f - vec2(0.0, 1.0));
      float b = mix(u, w, s.x);
      n[c] = mix(a, b, s.y);
    }
    sum += n * ratio;
    v *= 2.0;
    ratio *= 0.5;
  }
  vec4 c = clamp(sum * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  return vec4(c.rgb * c.a, c.a);
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
  ivec2 p = ivec2(fragCoord);
  bool keeps = p.y == 0 && p.x < STATE;
  // the noise is baked where the state begins afresh or the canvas has a new size, and kept from the frame before
  // elsewhere; a texel of the noise alone keeps what its buffer held two frames before, the same noise, once both of
  // the buffer's two copies hold it: nothing to write
  bool bake = iFrame == 0 || state(iChannel0, T_MARK) != vec2(MAGIC, SCENE) || state(iChannel0, T_STAMP) != iResolution.xy;
  if (!keeps && !bake && state(iChannel0, T_SEEN) == iResolution.xy) discard;
  vec2 noise = texelFetch(iChannel0, p, 0).rg;
  if (bake) {
    // as an 8-bit texture keeps it: each channel to the nearest of 255 levels, ties to even
    vec4 k = roundEven(turbulence(fragCoord) * 255.0);
    noise = vec2(k.r + 256.0 * k.g, k.b + 256.0 * k.a);
  }
  // the player's numbers in the first row's texels, run only there: a loop the other texels never enter costs them
  // nothing on most GPUs
  vec2 numbers = vec2(0.0);
  for (int once = 0; once < (keeps ? 1 : 0); once++) numbers = stateTexel(p.x);
  fragColor = vec4(noise, numbers);
}
